name: EvidenceRef
description: A stable, version-aware reference to evidence from any host-readable source.

id.description: Stable host evidence id used by claims, suggestions, and action proposals; distinct from the AST block id.

source_type.description: Open source category such as transcript, note, event, file, or URL. The reserved scripture value activates the relaymark.scripture_span profile.

source_revision.description: Immutable source revision id, digest, or version token when available.

selector.description: Host-interpreted locator such as a time range, text range, field path, or page region. Scripture sources require a lossless relaymark.scripture_span selector.

validation: id must be unique within the document and stable across regenerated revisions
source must resolve through the host or remain an explicit unresolved review issue
source_revision should identify immutable evidence when the host can provide one
selector semantics are defined by source_type and validated by the host
source_type scripture requires source to resolve to one scripture resource and source_revision to equal its corpus_release_id
scripture selectors preserve chapter-or-section coordinates and verse_label as a string; ordering is validated against the release coordinate inventory
scope must be allowed by the current document and user scope
